author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**


GO:0140662 | ATP-dependent protein folding chaperone | IEA with IPR013126


* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC664.11


* **Description of issue**

IPR013126 includes different types of ATPse activities. This orthologous group is 
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0140663
ATP-dependent FeS chaperone activity
See
https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/19963

Although FunFam has the necessary specificity, Panther and Pfam lump these different ATPases
title: IPR013126 not GO:0140662 | ATP-dependent protein folding chaperone | IEA

author: ValWood
source_title: NTR ATPase activity, coupled to translocation of iron-sulfur clusters

author: blazaropinto
body:

Beatriz

author: ValWood
body:
The conversation in  https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/19963 continued yesterday, we realised 
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0140663
ATP-dependent FeS chaperone activity

I'll keep you posted when we figure it out!
